response.sql: WITH per_telescope_avg AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) as avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), first_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as baseline1 FROM per_telescope_avg), above_first AS (SELECT avg_pulse FROM per_telescope_avg WHERE avg_pulse > (SELECT baseline1 FROM first_baseline)), second_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as baseline2 FROM above_first), final_set AS (SELECT avg_pulse FROM above_first WHERE avg_pulse > (SELECT baseline2 FROM second_baseline)) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) as mean_avg_pulse, AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT baseline1 FROM first_baseline)) as mean_excess_first, AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT baseline2 FROM second_baseline)) as mean_excess_second FROM final_set
